Pictet North America Advisors Sa increased its stake in Bhp Billiton Ltd (BHP) by 201.06% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Pictet North America Advisors Sa bought 76,000 shares as the company’s stock declined 2.00% with the market. The institutional investor held 113,800 shares of the precious metals company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $2.63 million, up from 37,800 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Pictet North America Advisors Sa who had been investing in Bhp Billiton Ltd for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $134.08B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.11% or $0.57 $50.81. About 1.56 million shares traded. BHP Billiton Limited (NYSE:BHP) has risen 23.08% uptrending. It has outperformed by 11.53% the S&P500.
